hero.name: Alok
hero.title: AI Engineer
hero.subTitle: Designing & Shipping Scalable AI Systems
hero.valueStatement: Building agentic LLM workflows, RAG pipelines, and real-time vision systems that drive business impact.

content: I’m an AI Engineer and IIT Dharwad M.Tech graduate who enjoys building intelligent systems that actually ship.
From agentic LLM workflows and RAG pipelines to real-time computer vision and generative models, I focus on creating AI solutions that are fast, reliable, and production-ready.
I care deeply about clean system design, measurable performance improvements, and responsible AI that solves real problems.

subSections.name: Deep Research Agent
bullets: Architected a two-tier orchestrator/sub-agent framework using LangGraph and Deep Agents, utilizing a DeepSeek V4 Flash classifier (100% routing accuracy, 0.9s latency) to dynamically route queries between immediate execution and collaborative, user-approved research plans.

Built 8 custom tools (including OSM Overpass for GPS search, Exa neural search, and financial APIs) with robust fallback chains, executing up to 3 sub-agents concurrently and offloading synchronous blocking calls via asyncio.

Engineered a two-layer cache (Redis for API data + OpenRouter prompt caching) and streamed real-time execution checkpoints over NATS JetStream to compile structured JSON block responses (interactive maps, sortable tables, and charts).

subSections.name: Document Agent
bullets: Developed an asynchronous document processing microservice using FastAPI and NATS JetStream to orchestrate background OCR, LLM-based summarization (DeepSeek V4), and multi-lingual translation jobs.
Built a hybrid, two-tier OCR pipeline utilizing PyMuPDF for instant local text extraction (< 50ms latency) and Mistral OCR 3 API as a fallback, reducing external API consumption by an estimated 75%.

Architected a secure and resilient system integrating PostgreSQL for transactional state tracking, Redis for message deduplication, and Cloudflare R2 with automated lifecycle policies for secure, transient file storage.

subSections.name: Github Agent
bullets: Designed and built an event-driven agentic workflow engine using LangGraph and LangChain to automate 50+ granular GitHub REST API operations (pull requests, workflows, code reviews, and branch protection) from natural language commands.
Implemented a multi-LLM dynamic fallback router supporting DeepSeek-v4-flash, MiniMax, and GPT-4o, reducing agent downtime and optimizing API token costs using a strict temperature policy (0.1).
Developed a deterministic UUIDv7-based memory tagging algorithm to enforce message idempotency, preventing duplicate memory updates across the execution graph on NATS message redeliveries.

subProjects.name: HeyVision — AI Coach Productivity Platform (US Client)

subSections.name: Meeting Automation & Analytics
bullets: Designed an event-driven microservice using FastAPI, Apache Kafka, and Debezium (CDC) to orchestrate real-time meeting streams.

Built a stateful scheduling agent using LangGraph and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to analyze free/busy calendar data and automate bookings. Integrated Recall.ai and OpenAI LLMs for audio-to-text (STT) transcription and automated extraction of action items, summaries, and sentiment insights.

subSections.name: AI-Powered Email Assistant
bullets: Built an event-driven email sync pipeline with the Gmail API using a Redis-backed arq worker, exposing 48 REST API endpoints.

Developed stateful agent graphs using LangGraph and DeepSeek-V3 to run background email classification, tone analysis, and context-aware draft generation. Implemented a dual-engine search combining PostgreSQL FTS and semantic vector search using Qdrant (merged via RRF) to optimize retrieval precision.

subProjects.name: Clovix — AI-Powered Sales Intelligence & Call Assignment System (US Client)
bullets: Built a LLM-powered sales call analysis pipeline using GPT-4 with structured outputs, distilled to Qwen-235B to achieve a 13× cost reduction with only 2–3% accuracy tradeoff (validated via LangSmith).

Designed a semantic call assignment engine using Qdrant Vector DB (OpenAI embeddings, cosine similarity) and Laplace-smoothed conversion scoring to rank and pair sales representatives with incoming leads.
Implemented a UCB1 multi-armed bandit scoring algorithm to optimize lead routing workflows, balancing top-performing agents while resolving cold-start biases.

subProjects.name: Falcon — AI Co-Pilot for Waste-to-Energy Optimization (US Client)
bullets: Built a hierarchical multi-agent research system using LangGraph + EXA to automate municipal waste data collection across government, non-government, and image-based sources.
Optimized execution through parallel research and extraction pipelines, reducing end-to-end city analysis from days of manual work to ~3–5 minutes per city.
Extended the platform into food waste and plastic analytics pipelines using GPT-4.1 + EXA, achieving ~92–95% accuracy at $0.015–0.04 per query.

projects.title: AI-Interviewer
projects.description: Multi-agent mock interview platform utilizing LangGraph for orchestrated agent interactions.
projects.quote: Simulating real-world interviews with autonomous agents.
projects.fullDescription: A sophisticated multi-agent system where different LLM agents take on roles of interviewer, candidate, and evaluator. Uses LangGraph for state management and orchestration, providing real-time feedback and dynamic conversation flow.
projects.architecture: Features a supervisor node orchestrating actor-critic agents. Frontend in React streams tokens for realtime experience.

projects.title: AskMyPDF
projects.description: High-performance RAG chatbot for chatting with PDF documents.
projects.fullDescription: Retrieval Augmented Generation system capable of ingesting large PDFs, chunking content efficiently, and retrieving contextually relevant answers using vector search (FAISS) and open-source models (Groq LLaMA).
projects.architecture: Ingestion pipeline -> Text Splitter -> Embedding Model -> Vector DB -> Retrieval -> LLM Generation.

projects.title: CrowdFlow
projects.description: Real-time people counting and tracking system for density analysis.
projects.quote: Real-time tracking with high occlusion robustness.
projects.fullDescription: Computer vision pipeline detecting and tracking individuals in video feeds. Uses YOLOv8 for detection and SORT (Simple Online and Realtime Tracking) for assigning IDs across frames.
projects.architecture: Frame capture -> Preprocessing -> Detection (YOLO) -> Tracking (SORT) -> Counting Logic -> Dashboard.

projects.title: Diffusion Model
projects.description: Implementation of Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM) from scratch.
projects.fullDescription: Faithful implementation of the DDPM paper. Includes a custom U-Net architecture with attention mechanisms and a scheduled noise addition/removal process.
projects.architecture: Forward process (adding Gaussian noise) and Reverse process (learning to denoise via U-Net).

projects.title: DualWaveNet
projects.description: Multimodal Vision Transformer for audiovisual classification.
projects.quote: Fusing sight and sound for better classification.
projects.fullDescription: Research project exploring early vs late fusion techniques in Vision Transformers for classifying video content based on both visual and audio cues.
projects.architecture: Two-stream transformer architecture merging attention maps from video frames and spectrograms.

thesis.title: FORGET – Instance-Wise Data Unlearning for Pretrained Models
thesis.description: Addressed the critical need for 'right to be forgotten' in AI models. Developed methods to selectively unlearn specific data instances from pretrained models without retraining from scratch, preserving model utility while ensuring data privacy.
